# TradeHQ

> TradeHQ is a free, no-signup paper-trading simulator for stocks, crypto, ETFs, forex, and commodities. Beginners get $100,000 in virtual cash, an AI mentor, live-style charts, and a public leaderboard to practice trading without risking real money.

TradeHQ is an educational simulator (not a brokerage). All prices are simulated for practice. Content is written and maintained by Anuga Weerasinghe. TradeHQ does not provide financial advice.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.thetradehq.com/): What TradeHQ is, how the free simulator works, key features.
- [Trade](https://www.thetradehq.com/trade): Live-style trading terminal with 150+ practice assets.
- [Markets](https://www.thetradehq.com/markets): Full asset universe — stocks, crypto, ETFs, forex, commodities.
- [Portfolio](https://www.thetradehq.com/portfolio): Virtual portfolio, P&L, Sharpe ratio, drawdown analytics.
- [Leaderboard](https://www.thetradehq.com/leaderboard): Public ranking of virtual traders by return.
- [AI Mentor](https://www.thetradehq.com/ai-mentor): AI-powered trading coach for beginners.
- [About](https://www.thetradehq.com/about): Mission, creator, transparency.
- [Contact](https://www.thetradehq.com/contact): How to reach the TradeHQ team.

## Learn (courses & guides)

- [Learn hub](https://www.thetradehq.com/learn): Free structured trading courses for beginners.
- [Trading Guide 2026](https://www.thetradehq.com/learn-trading-guide): Comprehensive beginner-to-intermediate trading guide.
- [Structured Courses](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses): Four YMYL-compliant tracks with quizzes and completion badges.
- [Options Trading Fundamentals](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/options-trading-fundamentals): Calls, puts, Greeks, spreads and risk.
- [Futures & Derivatives](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/futures-and-derivatives): Contracts, margin, contango/backwardation, hedging.
- [Macro Reading for Traders](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/macro-reading-for-traders): CPI, FOMC, yield curve, DXY.
- [Trading Psychology Mastery](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/trading-psychology-mastery): Biases, tilt, journaling, discipline, drawdowns.
- [Roadmap](https://www.thetradehq.com/roadmap): Upcoming TradeHQ features and improvements.

## Wiki (defined terms)

- [Trading Wiki](https://www.thetradehq.com/wiki/short-squeeze): Plain-English definitions of 50+ trading concepts (short squeeze, RSI, MACD, order block, Fibonacci retracement, etc.).
